summary: Iteration 36 — MO-007 Universal Distribution Framework™ connector expansion (dev.to + Shopify + WordPress Developer Setup UI) and MO-011 QRU Media Starter Kit™ verified end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration36_mo007_mo011.py. MO-007 validates /api/distribution/connectors returns 9 connectors including devto+shopify+wordpress with correct configurable=true, config_fields (devto:['api_key'], shopify:['store_domain','access_token'], wordpress:['site_url','username','app_password']), config_secret, config_hint and honest can_distribute=false while unconfigured; /api/distribution/connectors/{id}/config properly rejects 400 for etsy (non-configurable), and rejects 400 for missing api_key on devto, missing access_token on shopify, missing username/app_password on wordpress; unauthenticated POST returns 401/403. MO-011 validates /config returns 13 components + 8 outputs + full label maps; /kit/{product_id} returns gate {treasure_standard, gold_standard, passed}, 13 components each with status ready|pending + source + detail, kit_completeness 0-100, and 8 outputs each with status ready_to_produce|blocked + requires + missing; /generate/{product_id} returns 200 (saved) when gate passed and 400 with a Treasure Standard blocked_reason otherwise; /kits list returns without MongoDB _id; missing product returns 404 on both endpoints; /governance-binding/strip/media returns >=2 governing standards. Frontend Playwright end-to-end verified on preview URL: Founder login → /distribution renders dev.to + Shopify cards with 'Developer Setup Required' and testids config-devto and config-shopify visible; clicking config-devto opens the connector-config-dialog with config-field-api_key + connector-config-save (Save & Verify disabled while empty); clicking config-shopify shows config-field-store_domain + config-field-access_token. Sidebar nav-media-starter-kit present. /media-starter-kit renders PageHeader 'Media Starter Kit', msk-governed-by strip with 2 standards (STD-00033 · QRU Media Intelligence Division + STD-00021 · QRU Experience Design Architecture), msk-product dropdown populated with 124 real products; selecting PRD-00078 loads the kit — msk-summary shows Standards Gate 'Cleared', Kit Completeness 92% (12/13 components ready), Producible Outputs 7/8; msk-components renders exactly 13 msk-comp-* cards with proper ready/pending icons; msk-outputs renders exactly 8 msk-output-* cards; msk-generate button is enabled (gate passed). No runtime errors on the pages.

design_issues.screen: Emergent visual-editor injection (all pages, including /distribution and /media-starter-kit)
issues: Pre-existing console hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — emitted by the Emergent visual-editor tooling wrapping <option> text in a <span data-ve-dynamic='true'>, not by application code. Already documented in iterations 34/35. No functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: MediaStarterKit.js loads /api/founder-inbox and slices the first 200 products for the dropdown (same anti-pattern flagged in iteration 35 for VisualStudio.js). Founder-inbox is an operational triage feed, not a product catalog. A dedicated /api/products endpoint would be a more semantically correct source and would avoid the current dependency on the Founder role/inbox visibility.

media_starter_kit.py build_kit(): `gold_ok = treasure_ok` — the Gold gate is currently aliased to Treasure. Comment states 'Gold gate is human-reviewed; treasure is the deterministic prerequisite', but that means the returned gate.gold_standard string (e.g., 'Pending Human Review') never actually gates POST /generate. If the intent is 'Gold must be Met to generate', /generate would accept a product whose gold_standard is only 'Pending Human Review'. If that is intentional (Founder approves gold outside the pipeline), consider renaming gate.passed → gate.treasure_passed to avoid ambiguity, or add an explicit `gold_required` policy toggle.
media_starter_kit.py _outputs_readiness(): `cls` parameter is accepted but never used inside the function body. Safe to drop from the signature.

routers/media_starter_kit.py generate(): the persisted record includes the full `kit_data` (with all 13 components including narration_script + caption_file .srt strings + full transcript). For long-form products this can inflate the media_starter_kits document into hundreds of KB. Consider storing only the assessment (statuses/detail/kit_completeness/outputs) and referencing external assets by URL/ID, or moving the large text blobs to GridFS.

distribution/connectors.py ShopifyConnector._base(): the fallback `dom.split('.')[0] + '.myshopify.com'` can be surprising for a Founder who pastes a full custom domain (e.g., 'shop.example.com') — it will silently rewrite to 'shop.myshopify.com'. Recommend either (a) requiring the full myshopify subdomain in the Developer Setup dialog with a validation error, or (b) documenting the rewrite behavior in config_hint.

DistributionCenter.js ConnectorConfigDialog: after Save & Verify, the dialog reloads the connectors list but does not surface the honest connection_status.reason inline in the dialog — the Founder has to notice the card silently flipping from 'Developer Setup Required' to a real 'Connected' chip. Consider showing the connection_status result in a small strip inside the dialog before onDone() closes it.

MediaStarterKit.js: no data-testid attributes on the summary sub-tiles (Standards Gate / Kit Completeness / Producible Outputs) or on the individual output status chips. For deeper e2e assertions (e.g., asserting kit.gate.passed=='Cleared' by reading a chip), recommend data-testid={`msk-summary-gate`}, `msk-summary-completeness`, `msk-summary-outputs`, and data-testid={`msk-output-${o.id}-status`}.

MediaStarterKit.js: load() catches the /kit fetch error but leaves kit=null with no on-page feedback beyond a sonner toast — if the toast is dismissed, the Founder just sees an empty state and no explanation. Consider setting a local error state and rendering an inline StatusChip 'Kit assembly failed' inside msk-assembler.

backend/media_starter_kit.py: `import media_intelligence as mi` — the module is only used to introspect `mi.INTEGRATIONS`. If media_intelligence.py's INTEGRATIONS list is later restructured (e.g., promoted to an async accessor), assess() and _outputs_readiness() will break silently at import time. Consider a small helper `_live_integration_ids()` in media_intelligence and importing that instead.

rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Nine soft observations reported as critical_code_review_comments: (1) MediaStarterKit uses founder-inbox as its catalog source (same anti-pattern as VisualStudio); (2) gate.passed is aliased to Treasure-only despite MO-011 CONFIG.approval.gold_standard_required=True — need explicit policy; (3) unused `cls` parameter in _outputs_readiness; (4) generate() persists full narration/transcript/.srt blobs into media_starter_kits; (5) Shopify store_domain fallback silently rewrites custom domains; (6) ConnectorConfigDialog does not surface post-save connection_status inline; (7) missing sub-testids on msk-summary tiles and per-output status chips; (8) load() error path leaves kit=null with no inline feedback; (9) media_starter_kit imports mi.INTEGRATIONS directly instead of via an accessor.
